scope: Repairs for confirmed automatic-screen-audit findings in Graves.P/Q, Morgana.W, Malzahar.W and Nami.E
hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(parsed object), consistent with sources.digest

validation.command: node --import tsx scripts/llm/champion-mechanics/check.ts research/champion-mechanics/26.19-v2 Graves.P Graves.Q Morgana.W Malzahar.W Nami.E

entries.basis: The scalar damage_multiplier is the source 25% reduction, so the typed record applies 0.25 rather than retaining the source's remaining portion (0.75). The effect text only says reduced damage and no alternate rule repairs this number meaning.
entries.resolution: 25% reduction retained as text and unknown other amount; no invented remaining-damage multiplier.

entries.sourceQuote: After 1 second or after colliding with terrain, it detonates
entries.basis: The only explosion rule requires time=1 AND terrain-collision activation. Both tooltips give alternatives, and even the candidate gap describes OR. No separate time-only or collision-only explosion rule preserves the missing alternatives.
entries.resolution: Explosion timing and terrain collision changed from an AND condition to an explicit OR text condition; the gap now records the schema limitation.

entries.sourceQuote: Damaging ranged champions charges the Shadow Assassin
entries.basis: The report says damage_taken makes Kayn take damage, but trigger.subject is target, not caster; the ranged enemy is the damage recipient and caster receives charge. Thus the alleged actor reversal is absent. The source's omitted detailed damage-origin qualification is separate from this inspected claim and is not silently promoted into a confirmed defect.
entries.resolution: Candidate intentionally left unchanged; automated allegation classified false_positive by source audit.

entries.sourceQuote: After 2.5 seconds or after Recasting, Kayn bursts out
entries.basis: Rule 8 is the timed Darkin heal branch. Rule 9 explicitly has recast, Darkin Slayer condition, and the same caster heal formula/effect. The alleged omitted recast heal is already preserved elsewhere in this candidate.
entries.resolution: Candidate intentionally left unchanged; automated allegation classified false_positive by source audit.

entries.sourceQuote: Morgana Heals for 18% of the damage dealt by her Abilities to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungle monsters.
entries.basis: The event is ability_hit on target, the damaged champion. The heal effect is independently and correctly on caster, and its text says Morgana heals from her ability damage. The automated finding conflates the hit recipient with the heal recipient.
entries.resolution: Candidate intentionally left unchanged; automated allegation classified false_positive by source audit.

entries.sourceQuote: This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 5% every time Morgana is healed by Soul Siphon.
entries.basis: The source reduces cooldown on Soul Siphon healing, but the sole cooldown rule requires damage_taken by caster plus a healed-by-Soul-Siphon predicate. The predicate does not replace the wrong event; incoming damage is an extra unsupported requirement.
entries.resolution: Cooldown reduction now triggers on a named Soul Siphon heal condition under other, not damage_taken.

entries.sourceQuote: Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack.
entries.basis: The summon effect's count ref is en:body:n0=2, which comes from max stack cap. The source and effect text instead give one base Voidling plus one per stack, hence a variable summon count. Correct text does not repair a constant count=2.
entries.resolution: Removed the stack-cap ref from summon count while preserving base one plus one per current stack in text and a gap. Added an epic-monster text predicate to the 50% damage rule.

entries.sourceQuote: Voidlings deal 50% damage to epic monsters.
entries.basis: The only typed condition is target_type=monster, so the replacement 50% multiplier applies to ordinary monsters too. Epic is present in effect text, but no epic-only predicate or separate rule restricts the typed scope. The source explicitly limits this modifier to epic monsters.
entries.resolution: Removed the stack-cap ref from summon count while preserving base one plus one per current stack in text and a gap. Added an epic-monster text predicate to the 50% damage rule.

entries.sourceQuote: Nami empowers an allied champion's next 3 Attacks and Abilities for 6 seconds
entries.basis: The cast creates the mark on ally and the attack/ability trigger is ally, but proc conditions test caster.mark=empowered. This checks Nami's mark instead of the empowered ally's mark, contradicting the source and mark creation. The same ownership error also appears in the slow and area branches.
entries.resolution: Empowered-mark predicates now check the ally in the slow, damage, and area branches. The 100 AP denominator is ratio_input, not flat slow amount.

entries.basis: The slow effect's en:body:n8=100 is role amount, not the denominator of its 5%-per-100-AP coefficient. The substantive error exists, but the automated pointer rules.2.effects.0.parameters.1 actually targets the damage effect's 20% AP coefficient. This finding has a valid issue and an incorrect localization.
entries.resolution: Empowered-mark predicates now check the ally in the slow, damage, and area branches. The 100 AP denominator is ratio_input, not flat slow amount.
